create_cell_variable: create a CellVariable with cell values, face centers, and boundary constraints for 1D FVM solver
compute_inner_grad: compute the second-order gradient on inner faces using a 3-point stencil for non-uniform grids
calculate_face_grad: calculate the gradient of a CellVariable with respect to faces using constrained boundary conditions
get_face_value: get the interpolated values of a CellVariable on the face grid from cell-centered values
compute_cell_grad: compute the gradient of a CellVariable with respect to cell centers from face values
